entry.title: Why Most Medication Apps Fail ADHD Brains
entry.summary: You download a medication tracker, spend twenty minutes setting it up, and stop opening it by Thursday. The problem isn't you. It's that most ADHD medication app design demands the exact cognitive skills the condition impairs. Key takeaway: ADHD impairs executive function - working memory, task initiation, time perception. Most medication trackers are built assuming those skills work fine. The result: 54% of users drop out within weeks. Apps that survive on ADHD phones share a pattern.
